source: Existing IID native DCP phase qubits with public uniform labels; consumed once. No reusable phase oracle, free conditional copies or new toy problem.
mechanism: Known commuting CSS Pauli action from full-rank binary self-orthogonal M, followed by full Boolean Fourier readout. Distinct native labels are allowed for this raw measurement; same-state literature guarantees are not imported.

local_results.target_loss: Fixed-label product packet Pauli anyonic stabilizer is identical for every odd secret, despite different raw measurement laws.
local_results.noncentral_action: Dihedral irrep rotation/reflection commutator is scalar only when 4k=0 modN; generic noncentral commutators cannot be neutralized as scalar cocycles.
local_results.exact_kernel: For secret order>=4, IID uniform labels and prelabel fixed M: K(s,s)=sum_v 2^(dim(C_v)-wt(v)); K(s,t)=1 off negation orbits.
local_results.matched_baseline: Systematic M=[I,A] gives AA^T=I and K<= (3/2)^h. Bell pairs attain this using2h<=r native qubits. This is chi-squared signal only, not transcript/sample/time dominance.
local_results.individual_readout_baseline: Individual X readout uses2h native qubits for2h output bits with kernel(3/2)^(2h); its proposed-secret likelihood costsO(h) cosine factors. No efficient full-secret search or classical phase-state simulator inferred.
local_results.retained_quantum_escape: Outcome-only ceiling excludes no retained-register decoder. Overlapping six-qubit/two-row code without all-ones leaves2 encoded qubits; seven of eight unfiltered source controls distinguish s/-s with identical classical outcomes. All-ones controls instead erase that distinction.
local_results.concrete_native_state: All-zero measured-generator branch has unnormalized logical amplitudes exp(i sum theta/2)*(C_p+(-1)^a i S_p)/4, with C/S products of three pair half-angle cosines/sines. Branch probability and all parent outcomes are retained; no reusable phase oracle or new decoder.
local_results.sq_scope: Bounded one-record expectation queries at tolerance tau have a Bessel/reference-path screen; raw samples, current-label-adaptive codes and multirecord inference are not excluded. Screen can be vacuous at growing h.
local_results.physical_cost: r standard native full-oracle bridge queries, <=2 sum(rowweights) known two-qubit Clifford gates and4h Hadamards in the purified readout. No state cloning or postselection.

dependencies: known binary code with MM^T=0 and full row rank

proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-TARGET: Learned subgroup or statistic must preserve enough full-secret information; a shared odd-secret stabilizer is insufficient.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-REPRESENTATION: Known gauge, scalar cocycle and a genuine abelian projective action; noncentral dihedral commutator is not a scalar phase.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-SOURCE: Charge native states, actual labels, failed selection and any repeated conditional-state preparation; no free inverse or cloning.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-SELECTION: If M depends on current labels, do not use the fixed-M IID moment formula without a new conditioned-source proof.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-DECODE: Give a uniform full-record algorithm and total runtime beyond a chi-squared benchmark. Compare against known sieves, Bell/readout inference and classical label-relation search.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-BASELINE: Specify an actual improvement beyond the matched signal ceiling: inference, noise, compiler resources, higher moments or a new reduction.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-REVIEW: Independently review source character averages, shortened-code/systematic bound, target-loss and SQ scopes. No independent theorem review yet.
